title: Me, Myself & Irene
tagline: Table for two. Make that three.
about: A pushover Rhode Island state trooper with a nasty second personality called Hank has to get a woman on the run from Massena back home.
cue: Serve the sirloin when Boshane reports six bullets in a prize cow.
faces: COFFEE SHOP BY THE FRONT OFFICE
An 18-year Rhode Island state trooper. Clear broth, clams, potato and bacon.
I got no beef with you, says Hank. Smoky black beans, cheese, jalapenos, sour cream.
Six bullets, and the cow's lucky to be alive. Grilled sirloin, pepper sauce, fries.
Hank yells: free hot dogs, all you can eat. Rhode Island wieners, meat sauce, onion, celery salt.
Prices subject to change. Ask the desk about Hank, Charlie's other half. Card No. 18.
You would not believe this place.
Charlie's like origami, he folds under pressure.

Clear broth, clams, potato and bacon.How to make it3 rashers of bacon, diced1 brown onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced500g waxy potatoes, diced2 x 290g tins of baby clams, juice kept500ml fish stock2 thyme sprigs2 tbsp chopped parsley1 cup small salted crackersDice the vegetables, then fry the bacon until crisp, add the onion and celery and soften.Add the potatoes, clam juice, stock and thyme and simmer until the potatoes are tender.Stir in the clams and warm through, then season with lots of pepper.Finish with parsley and serve with crackers.Hank's black bean chilli nachosI got no beef with you, says Hank. Smoky black beans, cheese, jalapenos, sour cream.How to make it2 x 400g tins of black beans, drained400g tin crushed tomatoes1 red onion, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin230g corn chips200g cheddar, grated1/4 cup pickled jalapenos150g sour cream1 avocadoSoften the onion and garlic in a little oil, add the spices, beans and tomatoes and simmer until thick.Layer the corn chips, chilli and cheese on a tray and bake at 200°C until the cheese melts.Top with jalapenos, sour cream and smashed avocado.Buttered johnnycake bitesFrom Rhode Island, like Charlie and the boys.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Blue PlatesLucky prize cow sirloinSix bullets, and the cow's lucky to be alive. Grilled sirloin, pepper sauce, fries.How to make it4 x 250g sirloin steaks1 tbsp olive oil1kg frozen shoestring fries20g butter1 French shallot, finely chopped2 tsp cracked black pepper125ml beef stock150ml thickened cream1 tsp Dijon mustardBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Rub the steaks with oil and salt and grill over high heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest.Soften the shallot in the butter, add the pepper, stock, cream and mustard and bubble until thick.Serve the steaks with pepper sauce and fries.Hank's free foot-long hot wienersHank yells: free hot dogs, all you can eat. Rhode Island wieners, meat sauce, onion, celery salt.How to make it8 long frankfurts8 long split-top bread rolls300g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced, plus 1 more for topping1 tbsp sweet paprika1 tsp ground cumin1/2 tsp ground allspice250ml water4 tbsp yellow mustard1 tsp celery saltBrown the mince with the diced onion, breaking it up very finely.Add the paprika, cumin, allspice, water and salt and simmer until saucy.Simmer the franks in hot water and warm the rolls.Fill the rolls with franks, mustard, meat sauce, chopped raw onion and a shake of celery salt.Pie and SweetsLieutenant Baileygates' apple pieCharlie makes lieutenant at last. Apple pie, cheddar crust, vanilla ice cream.How to make it300g plain flour180g cold butter, cubed60g sharp cheddar, finely grated4 tbsp iced water6 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced100g brown sugar1 tbsp cornflour1 tsp ground cinnamon1 egg, beaten500ml vanilla ice creamRub the butter into the flour, stir in the cheddar and enough iced water to bring it together, then chill.Toss the apples with the sugar, cornflour and cinnamon.Roll out two thirds of the pastry to line a 23cm pie dish, fill with apples and top with the rest.Brush with egg, cut steam holes and bake at 200°C until golden and bubbling.Cool a little and serve with ice cream.Coffee and PopRhode Island coffee milkCharlie's home state, Rhode Island.
